description: neuralese-direct-v3 (union r2, three phases: full-prompt warm-up 0.5 epoch, program-header direct_sft 1 epoch, whole-trajectory direct_trajectory 1 epoch) on BF16 Mellum2.1 with raw-token-v1 heads. Every difference from the base is declared in training/neuralese/line-parity.json. Backbone-inherent: the data binds the union's Mellum2.1 twin renders (full/, program-header/, whole-trajectory/mellum21; same document ids, splits and source groups as the base's lfm25 renders); grouped MoE kernel; maple output convention and Mellum's measured base gate_pass; MuonSR latent_lr 1e-5; Mellum's quantization component (as neuralese-direct-mellum-v3), its curriculum progress continued over the new phase: direct_sft [0, 0.35], direct_trajectory [0.35, 0.5]. Fit-only: window_execution packed. Supersedes neuralese-direct-mellum-v3 (4962-document data, two phases). History: recipes/HISTORY.md.

reference.source: BF16 Mellum2.1 (raw-token-v1 heads) on the 48 shared probes, 28/48 with the maple tool-call convention (runs/neuralese-direct-line-parity-20261011/mellum-base-gate-48.json texts, rescored mellum-base-gate-48-maple.json; plain math 10/12, tool 12/12, natlang test turn 5/12, open answer 1/12: answers run past the 256-token budget)

quantization.description: raw-recurrence-mellum-v11's precision points woven into the direct stage (owner rule: QAT in every stage), trained on the same SFT targets with no BF16 KL teacher (flagged, NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md). No preserve stream and no own gate: drift reference and behaviour gate are the shared monitor (in-run capture on the 48 probes), as on the LFM line.
